The name Ram is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', which means 'pleasing to behold' or 'God Rama'. Ram is the name of the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have appeared on earth to destroy the demon king Ravana. Ram is considered a strong and courageous name, and is often given to boys as a sign of hope and strength.
